title: What If You Got Paid $23,280 to Sleep?
description:
23,280 dollars a month. For streaming while he sleeps.

Sources:
- Wikipedia: Kai Cenat: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kai_Cenat

From Wikipedia (Kai Cenat): in March 2023 he was reported to make about $23,280 per month from his sleep streams, which had over 5.6 million hours watched (Streams Charts); on 28 February 2023 he became the most-subscribed Twitch streamer at the time, peaking at 306,621 subscribers; Forbes put his 2023 earnings at an estimated $4.7 million; as of 2026 he is the most-followed Twitch streamer, with 21 million followers. Not financial advice.

#shorts #kaicenat #streamer #howtheymakemoney
loop: So next time you take a nap, remember:
cta: Sleep stream or gaming stream? Comment your pick.

scenes.narration: 23,280 dollars a month. For streaming while he sleeps.
But people really watched. Over 5.6 million hours of sleep.
Then, awake, he broke a Twitch record. 306,621 subscribers.
Yet sleeping was just a side gig. Forbes estimated 4.7 million that year.
Now? The most-followed streamer on all of Twitch.
